svg.aria-label: The install, step by step: 1. One command: Adds Aurora's signed pacman repository and installs the aurora-theme package.; 2. Already built: Every part comes built for your Plasma: nothing compiles and nothing else downloads.; 3. One question: The aurora installer opens and asks which logo goes at the left of the menu bar.; 4. Backup: Saves every setting it is about to change, so aurora uninstall puts it all back.; 5. Look: Applies the colors, fonts, icons, cursor and keys, then puts up the menu bar and the Dock.; 6. Log in again: Log out and back in, and your desktop is Aurora.
